Approach: A (local HTTP stub on a random free port pointing CONFLUENCE_SITE_URL at it). Picked because the confluence connector reads CONFLUENCE_SITE_URL directly from process.env. No real Atlassian credentials required.
expectations.evidence: Approach A confirmed. run.mjs spawns http.createServer().listen(0, '127.0.0.1'), captures the assigned port, sets CONFLUENCE_SITE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port>. ConfluenceClient (via toolkit/security_check.validateUrl which only checks scheme is http/https) accepts the localhost URL. CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN is the fake string ATATTfaketoken000000000000.

eval_feedback.overall: 10/10. Approach A worked cleanly for confluence. Local HTTP stub serves GET /wiki/rest/api/content/1 with a stubbed page payload; CONFLUENCE_SITE_URL points at the stub; gather() with a deterministic mock planner dispatches the confluence subprocess; the connector resolves credentials, builds a Basic-auth GET, hits the stub, and returns a success envelope with the stubbed title + body. Idempotent across re-runs. resolveAgentCli returns source='bundled-self'.
